decision.observation: 8 mph, gear R, timer 23:54.878, all dots pale. The car sits on the gravel just left of centre, nose up-frame; the road winds up-frame through white posts toward barrels, tents and a lake at the top.
decision.hypothesis: The brake flipped the gearbox to R and the car is now rolling backward down the road, but its position on the gravel is good. Plain W should convert R -> 1 and head it forward up the road before it reverses into anything.
decision.memory: Braking from 15 mph costs more than expected: it dropped to reverse 8 mph and the timer jumped ~16 s. Brake taps should be kept under ~0.5 s when only a moderate speed cut is wanted.
